div.head: Cn 1027 13
div.ab: Ego itaque vobis notum fieri volo, quod eadem via qua exivi regrediens, Danemarciam eo, pacem et firmum pactum omnium Danorum consilio cum eis gentibus et populis compositurus qui nos et regno et vita privare, si eis possible esset, volebant; sed non poterant, Deo scilicet virtutem eorum destruente, qui nos sua benigna pietate in regno et honore conservet, omniumque inimicorum nostrorum potentiam et fortitudinem deinceps dissipet et adnichilet!

I therefore wish to make known to you that, returning by the same way as I went, I am going to Denmark, in order, with the counsel of all the Danes, to make firm and lasting peace with those nations and peoples who, had it been in their power, would have deprived us of both our kingdom and our life; but they were not able to do so, since their strength was destroyed by God. May He, in His loving-kindness, preserve us in authority and in honour, and henceforth confound and bring to naught the power and strength of all our enemies.
